Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard Sri Subedar Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioners as well as Sri Ratan Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State respondents and perused the record.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 06.07.2021 registered as Case Crime No. 218 of 2021, under Sections 420,
467, 468, 471, 120B, 406 IPC, P.S. Nawabad, District Jhansi, and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.

It is informed by learned counsel for the petitioners that co-accused persons have filed Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 12368 of 2023 (Rafeeq and 5 others vs. State of U.P. and 2 others) and vide order dated 09.08.2023 co-ordinate Bench of this Court has disposed of the writ petition.
4.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 12368 of 2023 (Rafeeq and 5 others vs. State of U.P. and 2 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The said order dated 09.08.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 12368 of 2023 (Rafeeq and 5 others vs. State of U.P. and 2 others) is quoted as under:
"1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Shri Martand Kumar, counsel for the respondent no.3 as also learned AGA for the State-respondents.
2. Learned counsel for the parties submit that they have settled their differences outside court and have entered into a compromise.
3. The writ petition is disposed of granting liberty to the parties to file alleged compromise before the Investigating Officer, who shall examine the same and thereafter proceed strictly in accordance with law.
4. Subject to the above, this writ petition stands disposed of. "
5. In view of the above, this petition is also disposed of on the same terms.
